anyOf.description: content path of a material asset (no extension)

materials.description: material slots; a face picks one by index

smoothAngle.description: neighboring faces closer than this angle share smooth normals; 0 makes every edge hard; unit: °

uvScale.description: automatic UVs: one texture repeat per this many meters; unit: m

mirror.description: mirror a copy across the x = 0, y = 0 or z = 0 plane (edit one half, both change)

vertices.description: vertex positions; edit them in the viewport (poly edit mode) or with edit_poly

faces.description: faces as vertex index loops, counterclockwise seen from outside, each with an optional material slot
